text_markup: The Corp's turn consists of three phases. During the {term: draw phase}, the Corp draws the top card of R&D into HQ; during the {term: action phase}, the Corp spends [click]s to perform actions; during the {term: discard phase}, the Corp discards until the number of cards in HQ does not exceed their maximum hand size. Once the Corp's turn ends, the Runner's turn begins.
